name: mail-smtp-mcp
description: A TypeScript MCP server that enables LLMs to send outbound emails via SMTP with support for attachments and HTML content. It includes outcome-oriented tools for account validation and enforces strict security policies like recipient allowlists and size limits.

rawRecord.description: A TypeScript MCP server that enables LLMs to send outbound emails via SMTP with support for attachments and HTML content. It includes outcome-oriented tools for account validation and enforces strict security policies like recipient allowlists and size limits.

MAIL_SMTP_DEFAULT_FROM.description: The default sender address to use for this account.

MAIL_SMTP_DEFAULT_HOST.description: The SMTP host for the default account.

MAIL_SMTP_DEFAULT_PASS.description: The SMTP password for the default account.

MAIL_SMTP_DEFAULT_PORT.description: The SMTP port for the default account.

MAIL_SMTP_DEFAULT_USER.description: The SMTP username for the default account.

MAIL_SMTP_SEND_ENABLED.description: Must be set to true to enable outbound email sending.

MAIL_SMTP_DEFAULT_SECURE.description: Whether to use TLS for the default account connection.

MAIL_SMTP_MAX_HTML_CHARS.description: Maximum characters allowed in the HTML body.

MAIL_SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS.description: Maximum number of recipients per email.

MAIL_SMTP_MAX_TEXT_CHARS.description: Maximum characters allowed in the text body.

MAIL_SMTP_MAX_ATTACHMENTS.description: Maximum number of attachments per email.

MAIL_SMTP_ALLOWLIST_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed recipient domains (e.g., example.com,example.org).

MAIL_SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES.description: Maximum total message size in bytes.

MAIL_SMTP_ALLOWLIST_ADDRESSES.description: Comma-separated list of allowed recipient email addresses.

MAIL_SMTP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES.description: Maximum size of each individual attachment in bytes.
